# CANDIDATE: RSI_DIVERGENCE_VOLUME_CLIMAX

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Bullish/bearish RSI divergence at a swing point accompanied by a volume climax (2× average volume) predicts a reversal in the direction of the divergence. This edge exists because volume climax indicates exhaustion of the current move, and RSI divergence indicates weakening momentum, together signaling a higher probability reversal setup not captured by existing RSI divergence watchers lacking volume filters.

## Mechanism

Compute 14-period RSI. Detect bullish divergence: price makes a lower low while RSI makes a higher low; bearish divergence: price makes a higher high while RSI makes a lower high. Require the swing point bar’s volume > 2*average 20-period volume. Enter long at the close of the bullish divergence bar, short at the close of the bearish divergence bar. Exit shape: Stop at the opposite swing point (chart-stop). Target = 1*ATR from entry; allow runner to trail using a 15-period ATR multiplier of 2.5. Regime hint: Works best in ranging/low-trend conditions (ADX < 20) and VIX between 12‑22; avoid strong trend days where divergences often fail.
